coverage: Starter dataset for Houston, Texas and nearby Harris County communities; not a complete directory.
important_notes: Verify hours, eligibility, appointment rules, and service locations before relying on a listing.
Unknown values are null, not false.
SNAP/WIC acceptance fields apply to retail stores; they are null for pantries unless explicitly verified.
A food bank warehouse may not provide direct public grocery pickup. Prefer specific pantry/distribution sites.

resources.name: Houston Food Bank
resources.description: Regional food bank; directs people to partner pantries and meal programs through its locator.
resources.access_notes: Do not assume the warehouse address is a public grocery pickup site. Use the Find Food Map to locate a public-facing partner and call before visiting.
resources.food_availability_notes: Availability depends on the partner site and distribution.

resources.name: Heights Interfaith Ministries Food Pantry
resources.description: Community food pantry providing pantry staples, produce, eggs, bread, and other items as available.
resources.access_notes: Official site requests photo ID and a bill or document showing a Houston-area address. Contact the pantry before travelling; distribution may end when supplies run out.
resources.eligibility: Official site says Houston-area residents are eligible; visit frequency rules apply.
resources.food_availability_notes: Specific items vary; food may run out before closing.

resources.name: East Spring Branch Food Pantry
resources.description: Client-choice food pantry serving the Spring Branch area.
resources.access_notes: Official site says clients/family members are registered in the Houston Food Bank system and asks clients to bring ID for family members and proof of residence. Call or email to confirm current schedule and requirements.
resources.eligibility: Registration and proof of residence requested; confirm exact requirements with pantry.

resources.name: West Houston Assistance Ministries (WHAM)
resources.description: Nonprofit providing food distribution and other basic-needs assistance.
resources.access_notes: Official site says new-client registration is Mondays 08:00-10:00 in person, with limited spots. Food distribution is by appointment on some days and drive-through on Fridays; registration is required. Confirm current schedule.
resources.eligibility: Registration required; program rules may apply.
resources.food_availability_notes: Distribution depends on appointment, registration, and supplies.

resources.name: Target Hunger
resources.description: Houston food-assistance nonprofit with pantry appointments, public food fairs, and emergency food assistance.
resources.access_notes: This is the organization's contact address, not necessarily the location for every distribution. Food fairs and pantry appointments occur at different sites; check the current schedule before visiting.
resources.eligibility: Food fairs are listed as open to the public; monthly food assistance requires preregistration and may have income restrictions.
resources.income_requirements: Check the provider's current eligibility guidance for monthly food assistance.
resources.food_availability_notes: Locations and dates for mobile distributions change.

resources.name: Christian Community Service Center (CCSC) - Food Distribution
resources.description: Food assistance and basic-needs services; service-area restrictions apply to some programs.
resources.access_notes: Verify current food pantry hours and ZIP-code service area with CCSC before visiting; the address may be an administrative or service site depending on program.
resources.eligibility: Program-specific service area and eligibility rules; confirm with provider.

resources.name: City of Houston Food Assistance Resource Guide
resources.description: Official city guide listing multiple food pantries and food assistance programs. This record represents a directory, not a place to visit.
resources.access_notes: Use the guide to discover individual providers, then create a separate resource record for each provider/site.
